messages:
olivia: CI red on main — image publish failed at finalize. registry returned 409 then 500 on retry. Anyone free?
olivia: job link: https://ci.internal/runs/31234

ci-bot: build-image-frontend #31234 failed: push: error: http status 409 "layer already exists" then 500 on manifest finalize

dan: can you paste the full push log? 1-2 lines with the HTTP errors are enough

olivia: log snippet:
```
[...]
INFO: pushing blob sha256:abc123
HTTP/1.1 409 Conflict
{"errors":[{"code":"BLOB_UNKNOWN","message":"blob unknown to registry"}]}
Retrying...
HTTP/1.1 500 Internal Server Error
{"error":"finalize manifest: unexpected EOF"}
```

sam: quick thought — we recently reordered COPY in Dockerfile in PR #5217 which changes layer ordering. If registry has stale manifest for same tag, clients can race when pushing same manifest digest.

irene: also noticed earlier a 412 Precondition Failed on resumable upload for the same job id — could be partial blob state in blobstore

dan: two quick triage steps: (1) try a rerun with unique tag (e.g., {commitsha}-ci) so we avoid manifest clashes, (2) check builder cache / runner tmp dirs — persistent runner cache can reuse blobs and confuse the registry

olivia: triggered rerun with tag `frontend:pr5217-ci-1719992222` and added `--no-cache` to buildx. rerun: https://ci.internal/runs/31235

ci-bot: rerun started: build-image-frontend #31235

ci-bot: build-image-frontend #31235 failed: push finalizing returned 502 Bad Gateway

sam: still failing on finalize — suggests registry gateway / s3 backend transient errors. infra: can you check registry gateway logs + s3 upload latencies for the timeframe 1719992200-1719992600?

irene: checked runner node-7: found leftover tmp files under `/var/lib/containerd/tmp` from previous builds. Cleaning them now. Might explain partial uploads being reused.

dan: temporary mitigation: switch CI to use ephemeral kaniko pod per run or add `buildx create --use --driver docker-container --platform=linux/amd64 --name temp-<id>` so cache isn't shared.

olivia: updated pipeline to use unique tags and ephemeral builder, queued build #31236

ci-bot: build-image-frontend #31236 success — pushed `frontend:pr5217-ci-1719992222-2`

olivia: great, thanks. I'll follow up with an infra ticket to audit registry gateway retries and consider forcing idempotent pushes on our client side.

dan: filed INFRA-847: "registry gateway transient finalize errors; investigate blob GC and gateway 5xx" — assigning to @infra-team

sam: also added a short note to the CI docs about using unique tags for PR builds and avoiding shared builder cache to reduce these flakes :memo:

olivia: thanks everyone :thumbsup:

ci-bot: notifications suppressed for 10m
